allowed_wording: Can a reader distinguish low concern from low belief in control? In the 168-cell constructed map, a passive-prior agent with deficit sensitivity 1 is correctly identified at log odds 3 in 13.3% of 150-step uncontrollable worlds (95% block interval 9.0–17.7%), 58.7% of controllable worlds (52.8–64.5%), and 85.0% after an uncontrollable then controllable episode (80.5–89.5%; 300 steps total). These are descriptive constructed-method results, not evidence about people.
assumed_choice_model: Beta control belief, clipped logistic pushes and specified episode success probabilities.

reader: Eight exact finite prior/sensitivity candidates; complete action/outcome history.
